title: Environment Checklist
description: Schema for the Environment_Checklist.md structured data. Produced by environment-validation-skill during Gate 6 preparation. Validates that all environment variables are present, correctly typed, and distinct between staging and production.

checked_at.description: Timestamp when the environment check was performed.

lib_env_schema_path.description: Path to the lib/env.ts file containing the Zod schema.

variables_in_schema.description: List of environment variable names defined in the lib/env.ts Zod schema.

staging_validation.description: Validation results for the staging Vercel environment.

environment_name.description: Name of the staging environment in Vercel.

all_present.description: True if all variables in the schema are present in staging.

missing_variables.description: Names of missing variables (empty if all_present is true).

production_validation.description: Validation results for the production Vercel environment.

environment_name.description: Name of the production environment in Vercel.

environment_isolation_check.description: Check that secrets are not shared between staging and production.

status.description: PASS if all secrets are distinct. CRITICAL_FAIL if any secret is shared.

shared_secrets_found.description: True if any secret has the same value in staging and production.

shared_secret_names.description: Names of secrets found to be shared (empty if none). Note: values must NOT be logged.

process_env_usage_check.description: Check for direct process.env usage outside lib/env.ts.

status.description: PASS if no scattered process.env calls found outside lib/env.ts.

violations_found.description: File paths and line numbers where process.env is used directly outside lib/env.ts.
